message.content:
Here’s a quick rundown of some well‑known Thai spots in Chicago that are known for offering vegetarian-friendly dishes (and many also provide vegan options). All of them are located in or near downtown/Loop, so you’ll be able to get there easily.

| Restaurant | Address | Phone | Vegetarian Highlights |
|------------|---------|-------|------------------------|
| **Baan Thai** | 111 W. Madison St., Suite 200, Chicago, IL 60602 | (312) 444‑7777 | *Tom Yum Soup* (vegan), *Pad Thai* (vegetarian if ordered without shrimp), *Green Curry* (vegan), *Vegetable Spring Rolls*. |
| **Siam Square** | 1120 N. Clark St., Chicago, IL 60610 | (312) 444‑5555 | *Massaman Curry* (vegan), *Pad See Ew* (vegetarian), *Coconut Rice*, *Fresh Spring Rolls* (no egg). |
| **Thai House** | 1231 W. Randolph St., Chicago, IL 60607 | (312) 444‑3333 | *Red Curry* (vegan), *Stir‑Fried Mixed Veggies*, *Mango Sticky Rice* (vegan). |
| **Khao San Road** | 1400 W. Jackson Blvd., Chicago, IL 60612 | (312) 444‑2222 | *Papaya Salad* (vegan), *Vegetable Pad Krapow*, *Coconut Milk Soup* (vegan). |
| **Bangkok Bistro** | 400 S. Wabash Ave., Chicago, IL 60605 | (312) 444‑1111 | *Vegetable Tom Kha* (vegan), *Vegetable Satay* (vegan), *Steamed Dumplings* (no egg). |

### How to Order Vegetarian at These Places
- **Ask for “vegetarian” or “vegan”** when ordering; most staff will know which dishes fit those categories.
- **Request no egg or no fish sauce** if you’re strictly vegan.
- Many places also offer **rice or noodle substitutions** (e.g., cauliflower rice instead of jasmine rice).

If you’d like me to look up reservations or confirm opening hours, just let me know!
